About Me

I am an applied ontologist working at the intersection of formal ontology, conceptual modeling, and semantic interoperability. Currently, I am a Postdoctoral Research Associate at the University at Buffalo, contributing to the Clinical and Translational Science Ontology Consortium (CTSOC), where I develop ontologies to represent translational research across its scientific, regulatory, and social dimensions.

Previously, I served as a Research and Development Specialist and Lead Ontologist at Samsung R&D Institute Brazil—designing knowledge graphs and hybrid LLM-ontology architectures for health and well-being—and led ontology engineering efforts in international industry-academia collaborations between UFRGS and the University of Oslo (PeTWIN and Digital Geosciences).

Within the broader ontology community, I serve on the Editorial Board of Applied Ontology, on the Executive Council of the International Association for Ontology and its Applications (IAOA), and as Program Committee Chair for ONTOBRAS 2026.

Selected Work

  • 2027 Conference
    An Ontology Design Pattern to Represent the Selective Transitivity of Fluid Flow Connections
    Fabrício H. Rodrigues, Nicolau O. Santos, Joel L. Carbonera, Haroldo R. S. Silva, Mara Abel, João Netto
    Conceptual Modeling (ER 2026), LNCS 17081, pp. 200–216
    Synthesizes reusable ontology design patterns, industrial modeling, and automated reasoning—handling connections whose transitivity depends on physical structure and operating state.
  • 2026 Conference
    An Ontology Design Pattern for Functional Locations in Industrial Asset Management
    Nicolau O. Santos, Haroldo Rojas, Cauã Antunes, Fabrício H. Rodrigues, Régis Romeu, Rafael H. Petry, Mara Abel, João Netto
    Formal Ontology in Information Systems (FOIS 2026), pp. 230–244

  • 2025 Journal
    Toward a vector-based representation of dispositions
    Cauã R. Antunes, Fabrício H. Rodrigues, Mara Abel
    Applied Ontology, Vol. 20, No. 3, pp. 254–292
    Bridges formal ontological accounts of dispositions with vector-space representations for hybrid reasoning.
  • 2024 Journal
    O3PO: A domain ontology for offshore petroleum production plants
    Nicolau O. Santos, Fabrício H. Rodrigues, D. Schmidt, Régis K. Romeu, G. Nascimento, Mara Abel
    Expert Systems with Applications, Vol. 238
    Core domain ontology developed in the PeTWIN project to support semantic integration and digital twins in offshore petroleum production.
  • 2022 Conference
    “All the Things That Come and Go, Stop and Say Hello”: Towards an Ontological Account of How Participants Enter and Exit Events
    Fabrício H. Rodrigues, Joel L. Carbonera, L. V. Vieira, Mara Abel
    41st International Conference on Conceptual Modeling (ER 2022)
    Introduces formal ontological mechanisms for modeling dynamic participation and events that interfere with ongoing processes.
  • 2019 Journal
    What to consider about events: A survey on the ontology of occurrents
    Fabrício H. Rodrigues, Mara Abel
    Applied Ontology, Vol. 14, No. 4, pp. 343–378
    Comprehensive synthesis of formal ontological theories of occurrents, establishing foundational criteria for event representation.
